goal: Prevent Tor command injection and traffic hijacking from malicious or impersonated Tor control daemons
Ensure cached onion service IDs and private keys are strictly validated before reuse or advertising
reviewability: Reviewing logic now is worthwhile because the required rebase against master is mechanical
agreement: Strong support with all reviewer concerns about validation resolved
Substantive support for validating replies and keys from the Tor daemon (vasild, jeanpablojp)
Resolved concerns about argument injection via space characters in cached keys (jeanpablojp)
Resolved concern by replacing character blacklists with strict format validation (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents command injection vulnerabilities from untrusted or impersonated Tor endpoints
Protects node operators running Tor onion services from inbound traffic hijacking
